en.bdb: Man without Guru is the worst

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਂ ਗਭਣ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਣਦੀ ਪੁਤੁ ਸਪੁਤੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: maa(n) gabhan jeea jaanadhee put saput hovai sukhadhaiee|

en.bdb: A pregnant mother feels that a comfort giving worthy son will be born by her.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਪੁਤਹੁਂ ਧੀ ਚੰਗੇਰੜੀ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਵਸਾਇ ਨ ਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: kaputahu(n) dhee cha(n)geraRee par ghar jai vasai na aaiee|

en.bdb: Better is a daughter than an unworthy son, she atleast would set up another' s home and would not come back (to put her mother to trouble).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਧੀਅਹੁਂ ਸਪ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਜਾਉ ਜਣੇਂਦੀ ਜਣਿ ਜਣਿ ਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kudheeahu(n) sap sakaarathaa jaau jane(n)dhee jan jan khaiee|

en.bdb: Than wicked daughter, a female snake is better who eats its progeny at its birth (so that more snakes will not be there to put others to harm).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਂ ਡਾਇਣ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨ ਹੈ ਕਪਟੀ ਪੁਤੈ ਖਾਇ ਅਘਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: maa(n) ddain dha(n)n dha(n)n hai kapaTee putai khai aghaiee|

en.bdb: Than female snake a witch is better who feels satiated after eating her treacherous son.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਮ੍ਹਣ ਗਾਈ ਖਾਇ ਸਪ ਫੜਿ ਗੁਰਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਪਵਾਇ ਪਿੜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: baamhan gaiee khai sap faR gurma(n)tr pavai piRaiee|

en.bdb: Even a snake, the biter of brahmins and cows, listening to the mantra of the Guru would quietly sit in a basket.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੋ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੈ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: nigure tul na hor ko sirajanahaarai siraTh upaiee|

en.bdb: But none is comparable(in wickedness) to a Guruless man in the whole universe created by the Creator.
He never comes to the shelter of his parents or of the Guru.
